chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan mother in her fifties wearing a long bordeaux-red house djellaba with gold trim and a cream headscarf.
chars.SON: SON: a young man of 24 wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.COUSIN: COUSIN: a young woman of 25 wearing a mint-green oversized denim jacket over a white top, black trousers, a small brown shoulder bag.
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young woman of 22 wearing a short tight red dress, big gold hoop earrings and black high heels.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room with salon sofas. Seen from the doorway: MOM holds her son's phone close to her face and frowns hard with suspicion at a photo on it, one hand raised as if saying no. SON stands next to her, worried. Head-to-waist framing, faces clearly visible.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room. MOM shakes her head firmly and gives the phone back to SON with a disapproving look, arms crossed afterwards. SON looks surprised.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan kitchen. MOM points her finger at SON seriously while warning him, stern worried face. SON listens, leaning on the counter, uncomfortable.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room in the evening. MOM puts her hand on her heart with a knowing, worried look, explaining her feeling. SON sits on the sofa thinking, chin on his hand.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan street outside a cafe. COUSIN talks to SON with determination, hand on his shoulder, insisting she wants to meet his girlfriend. SON nods hesitantly.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Terrace of a modern Moroccan cafe in Casablanca. GIRL arrives in her short red dress, posing confidently. SON looks a bit embarrassed, scratching his head.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Table at a modern Moroccan cafe terrace with mint tea glasses. COUSIN sits across from GIRL and quietly studies her with narrowed suspicious eyes over her glass, while GIRL talks and laughs on her phone.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Narrow Moroccan street at dusk after the outing. COUSIN leans close and whispers a warning to SON, serious face. SON listens, shocked, eyes wide.
